facts.fact: StackAdapt was ranked a Top 20 Innovative Canadian Technology Company by the Canadian Innovation Exchange (CIX) in 2017.
facts.quote: has been ranked a Top 20 Innovative Canadian Technology Company by CIX (Canadian Innovation Exchange)

facts.fact: The CIX announcement that named StackAdapt was dated September 7, 2017, from Toronto, ON.
CIX received hundreds of profiles from all regions of Canada for its 2017 Top 20 selection.
facts.quote: Hundreds of profiles were submitted this year from all regions of Canada.

facts.fact: The 2017 CIX Top 20 Program had a record number of applications, according to CIX Executive Director Lauren Linton.
facts.quote: The CIX Top 20 Program had a record number of applications this year

facts.fact: The 2017 CIX Top 20 applicant pool included a high proportion of early-stage companies with less than $100k in revenue.
facts.quote: a high proportion of early stage companies with less than $100k in revenue

facts.fact: CIX chose Top 20 companies based on product/service offering, depth of management, market opportunity, and business model.
facts.quote: Companies were chosen based on a number of key factors including product/service offering, depth of management, market opportunity, and business model.

facts.fact: The 2017 CIX Top 20 list contained 20 companies, including StackAdapt of Toronto.
